_comment: token-bridge config. Lives at the ROOT of the TARGET codebase (not the plugin). The plugin is pointed at a codebase with --repo <path> and loads <path>/token-bridge.config.json. All paths below (source.path, emitTarget) resolve relative to <path>. Both token commands REFUSE to run while fileId is empty — a destructive reconcile must never fall back to whatever Paper file is currently open.

source._comment: The CSS/SCSS file tokens are read from. 'path' is relative to --repo. 'ref' is optional: when set (e.g. 'origin/main') the file is read from that git ref via `git show <ref>:<path>` instead of the working tree. 'prefix' filters custom properties (e.g. '--brand-'); null or '' takes ALL custom properties.

_primitivePattern_comment: Optional regex overriding how the component-harvest mapper tells a Tier-1 primitive (e.g. --green-500) from a semantic token, for the value-collision tie-break (semantic wins). Default (null) treats a numbered scale step — trailing -<digits> — as primitive. Set it when your primitives are named differently, e.g. '-base$' for --blue-base.

themeConventions._comment: How the dark scope is expressed in the source CSS. Supported: 'data-attribute' (needs attr+value), 'media-query' (needs query), 'class' (needs class). Class matching is class-token-boundary anchored, so '.dark' does not match '.darker'. When MORE THAN ONE is declared, exactly one must set primary:true — parse reads the primary's dark scope, emit writes only the primary's block; a single convention is primary by default. Scopes are found at any depth: @layer is transparent (a bare :root inside one IS the base), while @media/@supports/@container are conditional (a :root inside one is never the base).

harvest._comment: Component harvest (code → Paper). 'themeSignal' tells the live-page extractor how the rendered page reports dark: a data-attribute is read off the scope element; a media-query is read via matchMedia; a class is read via classList.contains on <html> or <body> (whole-token, so 'dark' is not satisfied by 'darker'). Shape mirrors the primary convention minus 'primary'. 'batch' lists the components to harvest — each {name, selector, route, trigger?}.
